name: Young Yahiko (S)
description: The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Yahiko is a stoic boy who leads his team in the fight for survival during the war.

skills.name: Water Style: Wild Water Wave
skills.description: Yahiko spews water in a waterfall-like fashion, dealing 30 piercing damage to one enemy and 20 chakra damage to all others.

skills.name: Lateral Kick
skills.description: Yahiko assaults one enemy with a lateral kick, dealing 20 damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Water Style: Wild Water Wave' will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Descending Fist
skills.description: Yahiko assaults one enemy with a descending fist, dealing 20 piercing damage to them and removing 1 taijutsu or bloodline chakra. The following turn, 'Water Style: Wild Water Wave' will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Magnificent Frog Disguise
skills.description: This skill makes Young Yahiko (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.
